name: Sonozaki Misao
source:
School: 2nd-year Kisaragi Vocational School
Description: she openly enjoys life
Profile: She's a waitress at Starry Sky restaurant. She is sociable and she is sexy and beautiful and most of all seductive. She enjoys life and doesn't want to take things too seriously because she's worried about the consequences. She loves having fun and she's very concerned about her appearance.
